questions.stem: How does the High Court of Australia protect human rights?

criteria.text: Demonstrates a clear understanding of how the High Court of Australia protects human rights
Demonstrates some understanding of how the High Court of Australia protects human rights
Makes a statement about the High Court of Australia AND the protection of human rights
Makes a statement about the High Court of Australia OR the protection of human rights

questions.sampleAnswer: The High Court of Australia has a role in applying and enforcing human rights laws which protects domestic human rights such as the right to asylum. The High Court can act as a check on government ensuring the executive arm of government acts within their legal authority. This is shown by asylum seekers appealing a federal government immigration decision. The High Court can also play a role in interpreting and developing human rights laws such as the common law right to a fair trial with access to legal representation.
answersCouldInclude: Note: Students may use an example to inform their response, eg Toonen, Teoh, Mabo, Wik.
